page.overview:
Who is Fyson?

During the "" , after asking for 30 pieces of to build more homes, will ask to find someone who would like to open a in . When asks if he should look for a traveling trader, suggests looking for a , as their flight could help with transporting supplies.

On 's journey, a group of bandits attempted to mug him, but he was able to fly away. Once he reached , he established the . He finds the to be great, appreciating the and that his mother can no longer annoy him. He is glad to be able to run his and sell what he wants to. He encourages to shop as much as he wants.

When speaks to him, asks how he is and claims to be doing great. Since is an adventurer, realizes that he need to carry a lot of supplies with him. He encourages him to buy anything he needs at the . If stands on 's table, he asks him not to do so.
